metadata.documentation: The 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler was equipped with RASS (Radio Acoustic Sounding System) for virtual temperature measurements. The Profiler operated in RASS mode for 5 minutes every half hour for most of the campaign. Two RASS datasets are provided: (1) daily 5-minute averages every 30 minutes and (2) moments with a 20-second average dwell. Refer to the data report for details on the quality and QC processing methods.
